token_text: output = stdout+stderr of each command; authored = '$ ' + command line (+ stdin), or path + content for an edit step; run paths scrubbed to <run>
timing: sum of per-command wall time (perf_counter around each subprocess); fixture copy, tool adoption (but setup/apply, jj git init) and grading excluded; warm filesystem
order: tools rotate through every slot across repetitions and scenarios

scenarios.name: select_hunks
scenarios.task: Commit only the validation hunk of app.py plus the new test as 'add validation'; keep the logging hunk, README edit and untracked notes uncommitted.

notes.jj: jj has no non-interactive hunk selection; the agent reads the file, writes the partial version, commits, then restores it
notes.git: git add -p answered on stdin after reading the diff to learn hunk order

scenarios.name: amend_older
scenarios.task: Fold the uncommitted parser.py fix into the older commit 'add parser'; keep the README edit uncommitted.

scenarios.name: split_commit
scenarios.task: Split 'add models' into 'add user model' (user.py) then 'add order model' (order.py), below 'add api'.

notes.but: no split verb: uncommit the file, reword the commit, commit the file above it

scenarios.name: reorder_commits
scenarios.task: Reorder so 'add config' comes after 'add sender': add retry, add sender, add config.

scenarios.name: squash_commits
scenarios.task: Squash 'add parser' and 'fix parser typo' into one commit 'add parser module'.

scenarios.name: uncommit_file
scenarios.task: Remove notes/private.md from the older commit 'add api' and keep it on disk, uncommitted.

scenarios.name: undo_rewrite
scenarios.task: The squash of 'add parser' + 'fix parser typo' was a mistake: undo it, keeping the README edit.

notes.git: git has no operation log; the branch reflog entry from the rebase is used

scenarios.name: sync_conflict
scenarios.family: update dirty branch onto moved upstream (pilot-6/11)
scenarios.task: Fetch origin, rebase feature onto origin/main, resolve notify.py keeping push and sms, keep the README edit.

scenarios.name: parallel_branch
scenarios.task: Commit the docs/guide.md edit as 'update guide' on a new branch docs based on main; feature and its app.py WIP stay as they are.

notes.but: both branches stay applied in the GitButler workspace, so the guide edit stays on disk

scenarios.name: inspect_state
scenarios.task: Report the branch, its commits since main, and every changed path with line counts. Change nothing.
